correctness.rationale: For n>=3, each vertex of a crown has exactly one distance-3 antipode. Independent sets are shore subsets or deleted matched pairs. This proves the exact distance-2 dominating criterion for color classes. The spectrum constructions meet all quantifiers, and exhaustive finite checks independently confirm the structural lemma for n=3..8 and all unlabeled color partitions for n=3..5. The computation is corroborative, not the basis of the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Crowns are a canonical connected bipartite family of diameter 3, exactly where radius 2 is nonautomatic. The result gives an all-coloring structural criterion and a complete spectrum, showing how one unit of allowed distance fills every gap between the two classical fall counts before radius 3 makes all proper color counts feasible. This is a natural exact classification motivated by the initiating paper’s move from existence to distance-sensitive colorings.
